trap.label: passiva técnica
trap.wrong: The file was save and the photo was putted on the wall.
trap.right: The file was saved, and the photo was put on the wall.
trap.why: Em português “foi salvo”, “foi colocado” são regulares; o brasileiro regulariza irregulares (putted). Em inglês: was + particípio (put não muda).

mcq.q: The photo was ___ on the wall.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Someone saved the file.”
Passe para a passiva: “Someone moved the desk.”
Passe para a passiva (presente): “Someone places the lamp there.”
